```{=html}
<pre class="pseudocode" data-line-number="true">
\begin{algorithmic}
\Procedure{Color}{$k$}
\If{\(k=|V|\)}\State output color; \Return true\EndIf
\State \(v\gets order[k]\)
\For{\(c\gets1\) to \(m\)}
\If{every colored \(u\in Adj[v]\) has \(color[u]\ne c\)}
\State \(color[v]\gets c\)
\If{\Call{Color}{k+1}}\State\Return true\EndIf
\State \(color[v]\gets0\)
\EndIf\EndFor
\State\Return false
\EndProcedure
\end{algorithmic}
</pre>
```
